ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, point $E$ lies on $AD$, and $EC$ bisects $\angle BED$, $AB=\sqrt{3}$, $\angle ABE=30^\circ$, what is the length of $DE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rectangle,\\
it follows that $AB=CD=\sqrt{3}$, and $\angle A=\angle D=90^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle ABE=30^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AEB=60^\circ$,\\
hence $\angle BED=120^\circ$,\\
Since $EC$ bisects $\angle BED$,\\
it follows that $\angle DEC=60^\circ$,\\
hence $\angle DCE=30^\circ$,\\
thus $CD=\sqrt{3}DE=\sqrt{3}$,\\
therefore, $DE=\boxed{1}$.
